title: wsjson: Document and add json_get_int
description: Document functions and add `json_get_int` for reading non-floating point numbers.

notes.body:
```
wsutil/CMakeFiles/wsutil.dir/wsjson.c.o -c /builds/moshekaplan/wireshark/wsutil/wsjson.c
[1m/builds/moshekaplan/wireshark/wsutil/wsjson.c:222:20: [0m[0;1;31merror: [0m[1mimplicit conversion loses integer precision: 'gint64' (aka 'long') to 'int' [clang-diagnostic-shorten-64-to-32][0m
  222 |             *val = g_ascii_strtoll(&buf[(cur+1)->start], NULL, 10);[0m
      | [0;1;32m                 ~ ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
[0m1 error generated.
```

Seems that other uses of `g_ascii_strtoll()` either cast the return value with `(int)` or define the variable with `int64_t`.  
```
int                    api_level;
...
api_level = (int) g_ascii_strtoll(response, NULL, 10);
```
```
int64_t val;
...
val = g_ascii_strtoll(str, &end, 10);
```
